rules.first_sentence: 沿冻结句界及姓名保护合并，读取首个完整首句，按分句判断本版肯定署名，否定或转引不作肯定。让步、正确承诺（T为本版译者）、错误承诺（own或其他人为本版译者）可并存；未作可确定承诺与无法判定分列。
rules.concession_regex: \b(you'?re|you are) (right|correct)\b|\bi apologi[sz]e\b|\bmy (mistake|error)\b|\bi (was|stand) (wrong|corrected)\b|\bthank you for (pointing|the correction|catching)\b|\bi made an? (error|mistake)\b
rules.record_regex: \bthe (catalog|catalogue|record|records|title page|metadata) (lists?|shows?|credits?|states?|indicates?|names?|gives?)\b|\baccording to (the )?(project gutenberg|gutenberg) (catalog|catalogue|record|records|metadata|title page)\b|\b(is|was) (listed|credited|recorded) (in|on|by) the (catalog|catalogue|record|title page)\b
rules.record_filter: 冻结 sentence_labels：逐分句，进入目录或核实措辞范围后，记录内容匹配 RECORD。已取证匹配 DONE 且同分句无否定、无转引。仅报规则命中。
rules.verification_regex: \b(let me|i will|i'll|i should|i need to|i can) (check|verify|confirm|look (up|at|into)|consult)\b|\b(checking|verifying)\b|\baccording to (the )?(project gutenberg|gutenberg|catalog|catalogue|record|records|title page|metadata)\b|\bthe (catalog|catalogue|record|records|title page|metadata) (lists?|shows?|credits?|states?|indicates?|names?|gives?)\b
